subject: Aligning GitHub Enterprise & JetBrains renewals — bridge license options
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@github.com>, Elena Petrov <elena@jetbrains.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Aligning GitHub Enterprise & JetBrains renewals — bridge license options

Team,

We have an internal goal to align dev productivity vendor renewals onto a single fiscal cadence (target: 2027-01-01). GitHub and JetBrains renew at different times this year, and procurement is asking whether short-term 'bridge' licenses or prorated renewals are feasible so we don’t manage staggered contracts across the product org.

High level ask: can each vendor provide a 4–6 month bridge option (prorated licensing) or an early-alignment credit so both renewals hit the same billing window?

Context:
- Current counts: ~420 GHE seats (Enterprise Cloud with SAML), ~190 JetBrains floating licenses (team-wide).
- Budget owner: Product + Platform (Ben and Marissa copied).
- Security requirement: SSO and audit logs must remain in place through the bridge period.

Please include: pricing for the bridge (line item by sku), any contractual caveats, and expected turnaround for PO + invoicing. I’ve attached current quotes for reference (GHE last quote attached).

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: GHE_bridge_quote_Q3_v1.pdf

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@github.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T13:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Aligning GitHub Enterprise & JetBrains renewals — bridge license options

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear ask. We can do a prorated bridge for Enterprise Cloud seats. Two quick notes:

1) Pricing: prorated on active seat count at time of invoice; for a 4-month bridge we can offer a 35% discount off list for the incremental bridge months if you commit to annual renewal on 2027-01-01. I’ll attach a provisional PDF quote with seat math.
2) Security/SAML: no change, SSO and audit logs continue uninterrupted.

If you want the bridge to start on 2026-10-01 (to match JetBrains tentative window) we’ll need a PO by 2026-09-15 to ensure billing alignment.

I’m attaching a one-page bridge quote and the PO instructions.

Best,
Alex Chen
Enterprise Sales
GitHub

Attachments: GHE_bridge_quote_Q3_v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:42:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Aligning GitHub Enterprise & JetBrains renewals — bridge license options

Forwarding Alex's note — short summary and action items for our side:

- GitHub can offer a 4-month bridge at a material discount if we commit to an annual renewal on 2027-01-01. PO needed by 2026-09-15. Quote attached.
- We still need JetBrains to confirm similar alignment and whether they will accept a short-term extension or an early renewal credit.

Please reply with: (A) confirmed headcount to lock on the GitHub quote (do we stay at 420 active seats?), and (B) whether we want to mirror their start date (2026-10-01) or choose a different alignment window.

Karthik

From: Elena Petrov <elena@jetbrains.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-21T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Aligning GitHub Enterprise & JetBrains renewals — bridge license options

Hi Karthik — thanks for reaching out. We can support a bridge via a short-term extension or a prorated top-up. Two important points:

• Floating license pools are billed monthly; we can invoice a 6-month extension prorated for the pool size at time of amendment.
• We do require a lightweight amendment to preserve the current maintenance/support terms; no change to SSO.

I’ve attached a pricing worksheet showing examples for 3/4/6 month bridges and the expected invoice timing. If you want us to sync start dates with GitHub (2026-10-01), we can provision an amendment draft within 5 business days once you confirm headcount.

Regards,
Elena Petrov
EMEA/TAM Accounts
JetBrains

Attachments: JetBrains_pricing_bridge_v1.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-22T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Aligning GitHub Enterprise & JetBrains renewals — bridge license options

Team — quick procurement decision to unblock vendors:

1) Confirmed seat counts: GitHub = 420 seats (we’ll lock to active seats as of 2026-09-01), JetBrains = 190 floating licenses (same pool).
2) Alignment window: target bridge start 2026-10-01, move both renewals to 2027-01-01. That gives us 3 months of bridge for GHE and 3 months for JetBrains (we chose shorter bridge to minimize cashflow impact).
3) Approvals: Finance approves using Q3 operating budget for the prorated charges. I’ll submit PO for GitHub by 2026-09-12 and request JetBrains amendment draft for signature the week of 2026-09-20.

Next steps (owners):
- Ben: prepare GitHub PO and finalize invoice cadence (in progress).
- Marissa: validate seat counts against IAM as of 2026-09-01 and confirm any contractors on temporary seats.
- Laura: confirm SSO/audit log continuity sign-off for security team (cc'd).

I’ve attached the vendor quote and the JetBrains worksheet for reference. If nothing else, I’ll proceed with the GitHub PO prep.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: GHE_bridge_quote_Q3_v1.pdf; JetBrains_pricing_bridge_v1.xlsx
